validation.method: Latest finishTime per target + test identifier; physical runner failures and iOS18 precondition probe excluded. Earlier tests count as latest available evidence, not a single final-source full rerun.

physical_ui.note: Final split core/Escape run waited for the locked iPad in Xcode destination preflight, then failed before test launch with a lost pending test-runner connection. No feature test body executed in that final run. Mac also relocked during remaining CUA checks. Both devices need unlocking before retry.

previous_completed_run.failure: Synthetic XCTest Escape did not dismiss overview. Fixed 44pt controls, existing cards and overview entry assertions completed before that failure. Sidebar follow-up assertions were not reached.

physical_ui.runner_error: Early unexpected exit, operation never finished bootstrapping. Lost pending connection to the test runner before launch.
physical_ui.follow_up: The user explicitly waived additional physical-device validation and requested pushing the implementation. Existing failures and unverified checks remain recorded; no additional device test was run.

direct_keyboard_check.method: CUA direct Escape key input into Simulator, separate from XCTest typeKey
checks: Escape closes an empty window overview while the inspector overlay remains available.
Escape closes the overview with the material-search text field focused and its caret visible.
A browser form filled using the touch keyboard remains unchanged after showing its actual web preview and returning with Escape.
direct_keyboard_check.automation_diagnosis: XCTest typeKey Escape uses synthesized U+001B text; observations suggest this path is not reaching the app key handler. The exact cause is not established. Typed and targeted diagnostic reruns still failed, and direct CUA success does not convert those XCTest results to passes.

visual_review.scope: CUA screenshots of the 11-inch simulator in portrait: empty overview, inspector overlay, and browser overview/return.
visual_review.note: The observed portrait layout was intact. Earlier exported XCTest screenshots had rotation/cropping artifacts (PNG EXIF orientation 8); these were not established as app layout defects. Geometry assertions and private-preview pixel checks remain separate automated evidence.

temporary_simulator_settings.reason: CUA corner drag did not resize the app; documented Globe/Fn shortcut cannot be sent because CUA reports keyNotFound(fn). Mac relocked before restoring the original setting.

data_conservation.scope: Copied Documents and Preferences from the ordinary device profile; aggregate values only, no material names or contents.

file_backed_validation_scope.limitation: No learning/quiz files or recording rows are present in this device backup; those formats have no populated physical-device preservation sample. External linked folders remain outside the copied Documents scope.

data_conservation.raw_byte_comparison_note: One JSON file was reserialized; its canonical JSON content is identical. All 141 existing material file contents are conserved.

remaining: XCTest Escape 실패 경로의 원인 확인 및 필요한 수정·재검증: 직접 CUA 입력 성공과 자동 테스트 실패를 구분해서 유지
